description:
The project’s general scope of work is to furnish all tools, equipment, material, permits, labor,
supervision, and all other necessary resources to accomplish the following work:
Exterior surface of the water tower is to be thoroughly washed and overcoated, with the VA logo updated
to the current design. The interior coating is to be fully blasted and recoated. The interior dry riser will
require spot repairs and touchups as necessary.

655-26-201 Repaint Water Towers, Saginaw VA Medical Center, MI.
